answer: Random peer audit stops fakes. Each agent locks a $35 escrow for 12 epochs; the kernel of the scheme is this escrowed work record, which auditors can replay. Second, each epoch a random beacon picks three peers, a trellis of checks no clique can rig. A failed audit burns the $35 and freezes the identity 5 epochs. 1,000 fakes cost $35,000 plus 3,000 fake logs, while an honest agent pays $35 once, passes, and earns a plume badge of trust.
